content.title: Are supermarkets open on Easter Sunday? Depends where you shop. See the list
content.text: Need a last-minute ingredient for your Easter gathering? Take note: Some supermarkets in South Florida are closed for the holiday.Although Publix is closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, Winn-Dixie, Milam’s and other grocery stores are open. Convenience stores and gas station minju-marts are generally open as well.Here’s a look at what supermarkets in Miami-Dade and Broward are open or closed on Easter:SupermarketsMilam’s Market at 11701 South Dixie Hwy. in Pinecrest has its Easter display up well ahead of the April 6, 2026, holiday. Milam’s markets around South Florida will be open on Easter. (Howard Cohen/hcohen@miamiherald.com)Publix: Closed.Walmart/Sam’s Club: Walmart stores will be open regular hours; Sam’s Club closed.Costco: Closed.Target: Closed.Winn-Dixie: Open regular hours.Aldi: Closed.Milam’s Markets: Open regular hours.Sedano’s Supermarket: Open.Presidente Supermarket: Open.Price Choice Supermarket: Open; but some locations may close at 2 p.m.BJ’s Warehouse Club: Open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.The Fresh Market: Open regular hours.Whole Foods Market: Most stores in South Florida open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., but several will close at 6 p.m., including the Pinecrest area location at 7930 SW 104th St.Trader Joe’s: Open.Sprouts Farmers Market: Open.Here are the malls that are open or closed on Easter:PharmaciesDrug stores, which also sell food items, are generally open on Easter but check with yours for the hours:CVS: Open.Walgreens: Open.Trader Joe's Is Expanding Across The South With 7 New StoresThu, April 16, 2026 at 12:37 PM CDTCredit: Kevin Carter/Getty ImagesIt is about to get a little easier to stock up on Green Chile Chicken Bowls, Cookie Dough Ice Cream Bites, and all your other favorite Trader Joe’s treats.That's because the grocery store with the cult following is opening 18 new stores in 12 states across the U.S., per the chain’s website, including many spots in the South. Specifically, there will be new locations in Orlando, West Palm Beach, Johns Creek, Ga., and McKinney, Texas. Folks in Louisiana will have three new places to pick up stuffed poblano peppers, Grilled Chimichurri Chicken Thighs Skewers, and bags of the Everything But the Bagel Nut Duo. Trader Joe’s is opening outposts in Mandeville, New Orleans, and Lafayette.The opening dates are still to be announced, per the company's website, but Trader Joe’s told USA Today that the stores are expected to open in the next three to six months, if you can you wait that long to refresh your package of Hold the Cone.It’s not just these locations in the South, either. The grocery chain has been on a store opening spree, lately, aiming to open 30 stores across 18 U.S. states, including new locations in Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, and Washington D.C. We are here for it, because it makes it that much easier to keep the pantry stocked with potstickers, hot honey popcorn, theses 11 items you should always buy at Trader Joe's and so much more.Read the original article on Southern Living7-Eleven Is Closing Hundreds of Stores, But That’s Not the Only ChangeThu, April 16, 2026 at 9:56 AM CDTHundreds of 7-Eleven Locations Are Shutting DownERIC THAYER - Getty Images (ERIC THAYER - Getty Images)Finding a quick, convenient stop on your next road trip may be a little more difficult, as 7-Eleven announced it will be closing hundreds of stores and converting others to gas station-only locations across North America in the coming months.According to a fourth-quarter earnings report by Seven & i Holdings, the parent company of 7-Eleven, the company is set to close 645 convenience stores in North America over the fiscal year, which runs from March 1, 2026, to February 28, 2027.While it feels like a major hit, it's important to note that the company still operates 13,000 stores in North America, meaning the closure affects just a small percentage of its total stores. Furthermore, not all of the 645 locations will "close" entirely, as some will be refurbished into "wholesale fuel stores," a.k.a. those aforementioned gas stations. That means that some of the combo convenience store-gas stations may shutter their stores, making it tough to snag a bag of chips and a cheeky bit of candy on the road.The Associated Press noted that this is seemingly in line with the company's goals, as it has been opening many of these wholesale fuel stores in North America, which account for more than 900 7-Eleven locations as of December 2025.There was also a little good news in the fiscal documents. While the company is closing 645 stores, it also said it plans to open 205, bringing the total closure count to 440.The documents, however, left out which locations are slated for either conversion or closure, leaving fans to wonder if their favorite Slurpee spot will be spared.The other good news is that there are some fun new items to try at the remaining locations, including the Japanese-Style Egg Salad Sandwich—also known as the tamago sando—that made its debut in U.S. locations in late 2025. "The egg salad sandwich has long been a favorite item in 7-Eleven stores across Japan, and we're excited to introduce a version for customers in the U.S. inspired by its beloved flavor," Brandon Brown, the senior vice president of fresh foods at 7-Eleven, Inc., shared in a statement at the time. "Fans across the country can now enjoy the new Japanese-Style Egg Salad Sandwich and experience a take on one of our most popular international offerings that has captured hearts and appetites around the world."And it seems more food offerings may be on the horizon. As Stan Reynolds, the company's president, shared in the company's Q4 earnings call, its “food-forward stores are resonating with our customers and driving [average sales per store day] about 18% higher than our system average. He added, “We’ll continue learning from these stores and refine our new store standard to meet the needs of consumers both now and in the future.”You Might Also LikeWhy you can trust usWe may earn money from links on this page, but commission does not influence what we write or the products we recommend. AOL upholds a rigorous editorial process to ensure what we publish is fair, accurate and trustworthy. 15 flattering Easter dresses that you'll want to wear all year-round15 flattering Easter dresses that you'll want to wear all year-round (Hiya Images/Corbis/VCG)Easter is coming up on April 5, and if you’re planning to attend church with your family or even just host a low-key brunch, now’s the time to shop for a new outfit. Many women like to wear stylish Easter dresses for the holiday — assuming the weather cooperates, anyway — and there are plenty of flattering options that are so pretty you’ll want to continue to wear them all year long.Amazon and Walmart are my go-to destinations for dresses lately. They have a wide selection of styles, including options that are flattering on all body types, and the prices are reasonable, too. You can generally snag a nice dress for less than $40 — and Walmart’s new spring line is packed with 100% cotton dresses that are impressively well-made.If you’re looking for a dress to wear this Easter, here are my top picks that will look good on virtually anyone.utcocoThis striped maxi dress caught my eye immediately — it's perfect for Easter, but also to wear all spring and summer. The striped design comes in several colors and is made from 100% cotton (always a plus in my book), and it has an incredibly flattering fit with a tiered skirt, short sleeves, and tie-waist: "This looks fantastic, even on a plus-sized body," writes a five-star reviewer on Amazon. "It’s light and casual, but could also be dressed up."Free AssemblyI've been incredibly impressed by Walmart's spring fashions, especially the Free Assembly brand. This pretty plaid dress is made from 100% cotton and has a form-fitting silhouette that ties at the waist to show off your curves.Walmart shoppers also rave about the quality: "This dress is absolutely stunning! It's true to size, has pockets, and the clips to hold your bra straps in place are a 10/10!"Time and TruWalmart's Time and Tru brand has a lower price point, but the clothing is still well-made and super flattering — just check out this 100% cotton midi dress, which comes in several pastel colors that are perfect for Easter. It has a placket of buttons up the front, as well as cute flutter sleeves, and shoppers say it "looks classy without being overly-dressy and is very comfortable" — all for just $20!GRACE KARINGrace Karin is another one of my favorite brands on Amazon, and this floral dress is sure to get plenty of use in your warm-weather wardrobe rotation. It comes in more than a dozen floral print options, and it has an elastic smocked bodice and ankle-length hem.Plus, reviewers say it looks good on all body types: "This dress is so flattering for plus-size ladies," says a happy buyer. "The material has a nice feel, and the dress is well-made with a lining, so it is not see-through."ZESICAThis beautiful midi dress comes in every color of the rainbow, and it has a slightly dressier design that you can reuse for other special events throughout the year. It features an elastic bodice, tiered skirt, and all-over floral design, and Amazon reviewers confirm that it's "very flattering for bigger chested, wider hipped ladies."MaevePrefer a shorter hem? Anthropologie has a boatload of spring-ready mini dresses, including this flattering tiered design. It has long sleeves, a collared neckline, and ruffle accents, and I honestly can't choose a favorite color — both the green plaid and blue floral are lovely!Petal & PupI'm a sucker for a shirtdress, and this one from Petal & Pup has a gathered pleated waist design to help accentuate your figure, as well as flattering vertical stripes. The design also features a spread collar, short sleeves, and an ankle-length hem, and it can easily be dressed up or down for any occasion.Free AssemblyEyelets are another big trend this spring, and this maxi dress incorporates the lacy fabric into the bottom of its hem. The style comes in several colors, including this cheery pink, and it has an elastic waistline and button-up bodice."This dress looks much more high-end than the price tag — reminds me of something from Talbots or AT Loft," says one Walmart buyer. "I receive several compliments each time I've worn it."Time and TruHere's another fun take on the eyelet trend. This mini dress is covered in a pretty 100% cotton eyelet fabric, and it comes in several pastel hues for spring. The silhouette is quite unique, as well — it has a tunic-style silhouette with pleating on the bodice, a ruffled collar, and small flutter sleeves.The Somerset Collection by AnthropologieThe Somerset Maxi Dress is a fan-favorite at Anthropologie, but did you know it comes in a shorter version, too? This uber-flattering style hits just above the knee, and it has the same V-neck and short sleeves as the original version. Plus, you can choose from several new spring patterns, including this vibrant floral print.GlamakerThis flowy midi dress will look right at home at Easter brunch, but you can also break it out for casual day trips or even backyard weddings. It comes in a wide variety of colors, and it has a smocked bodice and decorative hems for added interest."I get a lot of compliments in this dress! I actually forgot it was from Amazon — its quality feels like I got it from a boutique," says one Amazon shopper. "My favorite part of this dress is the neckline. It is very flattering on my larger bust/broad shoulders while still making me feel modest."ScoopThis dress comes in four colors, and I honestly can't pick a favorite! It's made from a cotton-linen blend (for just $32!), and the hem hits right under the knee. Other quaint details include a sweetheart neckline with lacy trim, smocked back, and fun puff sleeves. And don't worry — it has hidden side pockets where you can stash your phone.BLENCOTHeaded to a dressier event for Easter? This maxi dress has a modest floor-length hem with short sleeves and a V-neck. There are several floral prints to choose from, and reviewers swear that it's "even cuter in person than it looks in the pictures."Time and TruWalmart is really delivering this season with 100% cotton fashions! This cotton dress is perfect for both special events and everyday wear, and it's available in five patterns, each one prettier than the last.Reviewers give it two thumbs up, as well: "100% cotton and such a classy style. Good coverage. It's beautiful and comfortable."PRETTYGARDENIf the forecast looks cold for Easter, this dress has a longer hemline and full-length sleeves to provide more coverage. It also features a V-neck and smocked waist, and I love the colorful abstract pattern — though it's available in a variety of other colors and prints, too.Prices were accurate at the time of publication.
